reason: The handoff schema accepts the current outputs shape (id/path/frozen) but rejects W01-W09 historical outputs (kind/path/sha256), even though the teamctl validator and stored payload hashes accept these completed handoffs. Add a backward-compatible alternative to validate both representations without rewriting historical handoffs.
impacted_consumers: The handoff schema copies in .codex-team-kit/protocol/ and plugins/bago-agent-decision-engineering-team/protocol/
required_invalidations: Validate all 14 existing handoffs against the updated schema; preserve their bytes and payload_sha256 values.
decision: Accepted by user instruction to continue the identified cleanup; historical handoffs will remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
